description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
1.  Why are there multiple churches in the world when Jesus said: I will build my church, not churches.
2. Since Jesus didn't sin did he experience addiction?
3. Daniel 9:26
.
